description: Runs the Polyxd verifier's document checks: the spec validator, the pattern the surface declares, readable and distinct labels, one primary action per view, at most six inputs per view, entity-first flows, confirmations, and, when you pass one, a Design Direction's rules and voice. Returns a compact report. Example directions by name: calm-finance, playful-personal.

data.description: The values the screen shows, bound by {"path": "/pointer"}. Replaces the document's own "data" when given.

direction.description: A Design Direction to hold the document to: the direction object, or the name of an example direction.

document.description: A Polyxd UI document: {specVersion, surface, root, components, data?}. polyxd_guide explains the format.

registry.description: A capability registry ({capabilities: [...]}) to check the document's actions against. Leave out when there is none.

name: polyxd_verify

direction.description: The name of the Design Direction the document was held to, when one was given and it has a name.

errors.description: How many errors. Fix every one before showing the document.

findings.description: Every check that failed. Empty when the document passes with no warnings.

check.description: The check that failed, e.g. "spec", "data:missing-path", "pattern:<id>", "rule:<id>", "capability" or "load:inputs-per-view".

hint.description: What to change to fix it, when there is a known fix.

message.description: What failed; findings from the spec validator start with the JSON Pointer, as "<pointer>: <message>".

severity.description: "error" must be fixed before the document is shown; "warning" is advice.

rules.description: How many Design Direction rules were checked. 0 without a direction.

warnings.description: How many warnings. Advice; they do not stop the document being shown.

title: Verify a Polyxd document
